selection.method: Python random.Random(4606) over 2023-01-01..2025-11-20, seven-day windows, at least 35 days from every previously opened week and from each other

staging_contract: Open v6-week-1 only after the v6 code/config freeze. Open v6-week-2 only if v6-week-1 passes every gate. Open v6-week-3 only if v6-week-2 also passes.
